when_used: A lessor leases demised premises to a lessee for a term at a rent, on the registry form lodged for registration against the title.

detail_rows.label: Demised Premises (details to include as applicable coordinates of the land, the area of the demised premises and the number of the floor. Provide the survey plan registered as provided in the Act)
Cadastral Plan of the Demised Premises (where applicable)
Sectional Plan(s) of the Demised Premises (where applicable)

body_text.text: The Lessor as legal and or beneficial owner of the above noted Title HEREBY LEASES to the Lessee the Demised Premises for the Term subject to the payment of the Rent and the Service Charge and subject to the conditions set out in this Lease.

Insert Additional Provisions as required by the law and the contract between the parties including in the case of long term leases provisions on extension of lease and transfer of reversionary interest.
IN WITNESS this Lease has been duly executed as a deed by the parties hereto the day and year mentioned above.

foot_notes: All parties including the Guarantor(s) must execute.
**The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”

custom_fields.name: demised_premises
custom_fields.label: Demised premises
custom_fields.prompt: The premises let, with the coordinates of the land, the area and the floor number where applicable, and the registered survey plan

custom_fields.name: term
custom_fields.label: Term of the lease
custom_fields.prompt: The term granted, with its commencement date, for example five years and six months from 1st October 2026

custom_fields.name: rent_or_stand_premium
custom_fields.label: Rent or stand premium
custom_fields.prompt: The rent or stand premium reserved, and when it is payable

custom_fields.name: service_charge
custom_fields.label: Service charge
custom_fields.prompt: The service charge payable under the lease, if any

custom_fields.name: cadastral_plan
custom_fields.label: Cadastral plan of the demised premises
custom_fields.prompt: The cadastral plan number for the demised premises, where applicable

custom_fields.name: sectional_plan
custom_fields.label: Sectional plan(s) of the demised premises
custom_fields.prompt: The sectional plan number(s) for the demised premises, where applicable

custom_fields.name: additional_provisions
custom_fields.label: Additional provisions
custom_fields.prompt: The additional provisions the law and the contract between the parties require, one per line
